title: Dolan finds Timothy Good's Above Top Secret in a Syracuse bookstore

tellings.quote: I was in a bookstore, just like a ordinary bookstore, one day in Syracuse, New York, and I saw a copy of Timothy Good's very classic work, Above Top Secret.

plain: In 1994, in "just like an ordinary bookstore" in Syracuse, New York, the historian Richard Dolan came across Above Top Secret, which he calls a classic work by the British UFO writer Timothy Good. Dolan tells Michels this himself, as the chance find that drew him into the subject.
